free.question: Is it free for commercial use?
free.answer: Yes. It is MIT licensed: use it for client work or your own SaaS. Keep the license notice in copies of the code; nothing else is required.

serverFirst.question: Why no client-side data library?
serverFirst.answer: Server Components and Server Actions already cover reads and writes, and keep sessions, permissions, and database access on the server. The browser loads less JavaScript, and there is one source of truth.

deploy.question: Where can I deploy it?
deploy.answer: Anywhere that runs Next.js on Node.js: Vercel, a container, or your own server. On serverless, use a pooled PostgreSQL connection. The README has a production checklist.

customize.question: Do I have to keep Persian or multi-tenancy?
customize.answer: No. Remove a locale or a dashboard area by deleting its folder and its messages; the guides list the steps. Layouts stay correct for left-to-right and right-to-left either way.

aiAgents.question: Does it work with AI coding agents?
aiAgents.answer: Yes. AGENTS.md, task guides, and Cursor rules tell Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex where each kind of code goes and which existing feature to copy.

missing.question: What is not included?
missing.answer: Billing, a CMS, and analytics are left to you, so you can choose the provider that fits your product.
